t: This sculpture is Moments Contained, by Thomas J Price, at the Victoria and Albert Museum. Price is a British artist, born in 1981, who works as a sculptor. His figure Reaching Out, his first full-figure representation of a woman, has been shown as part of The Line in East London. He was also chosen to make the artwork unveiled in 2022 to commemorate the Windrush generation at Hackney Town Hall. Here, take in the figure itself and how it stands within the museum's setting.
